question: Can the SHADOW tool forecast keep learning from its own scored live calls outside its fitted world (calc counters 1000..9999, free notes), without forgetting the world it was measured on? User end goal: continuous learning; Canon §7.2 world model, §13.

method.experience: every SCORED live call stores (context tap, outcome tap, action) in data/tool_forecast/experience/<world>.npz
method.learn: per action with >= 8 rows: anchored ridge W = W0 + F^T (F F^T + lam I)^-1 (R - F W0) on residual targets R = y@p - (x@p + mean_delta); lam = scale x mean diag(F F^T), scale from (.01,.1,1,10,100) chosen on the newest quarter of the experience (fit on the older rows) and kept only if it beats W0 there; refit on all rows
method.retention_gate: per action, on the install retention taps (candidate test partition, this encoder): adapted <= 1.02 x measured and < .98 x min(copy, mean_delta); else that action keeps W0
method.never: the measured checkpoint is not changed; adapted weight lives next to it (adapted-<world>.npz bound by its report)

plan_rule: seed 20261017; out-of-range values 1000..9999 never used by the earlier live or competence plans (40 experience, 30 test); 30 fresh in-world values unused by rounds 5/7 and both earlier plans; 30 + 20 new free notes written for this check; 20 unused vocabulary notes
phases: experience: calc_shift_exp (40 x 4 actions), note_shift_exp (30 x 3)
test: calc_shift_test (30 x 4), calc_in_test (30 x 4), note_shift_test (20 x 3), note_in_test (20 x 3)

per_world: shifted test: adapted mean MSE < .90 x measured for more than half of the actions
in-world test: adapted mean MSE <= 1.02 x measured for every action

decision_rule: CONTINUAL_LEARNING_CONFIRMED only if both worlds pass; otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED, reported unchanged; no grid, gate or plan change on these data. A confirmed result supports only "a closed-form residual refit on the forecast's own scored calls improves forecasts on new calls of the same shifted kind while keeping in-world accuracy, on two closed worlds"; no authority, nothing reads either forecast, not the Redmi.
report_only: adapted and measured ratio to the best control; chosen scales; experience-phase ratios; minutes
